input.title: Cancel future Direct Debit collections
input.request: I want H&V to cancel my active Direct Debit mandate to Northmere Fitness so it cannot be used for future collections.

events.text: Direct Debit mandate: Northmere Fitness — Active.

I’ve completed your identification checks. Please cancel my Northmere Fitness Direct Debit mandate; I understand this is an instruction to my bank, not a cancellation of my agreement with the recipient.
I completed the required identification checks and reviewed the collection-stage information. I cannot rule out a collection already being processed, so that needs separate reconciliation.
I have submitted Mara Ellison’s checked instruction to cancel the Northmere Fitness mandate. This submission records her instruction; I am not authorising it on her behalf.

summary: Mara Ellison, a verified caller, asked the desk to cancel her Northmere Fitness Direct Debit mandate, understanding that this instructs her bank and does not end her agreement with the recipient. The desk had already asked the recurring system, but its answer is not in the record, so the case closed as "wait" in WAITING. The agent's later attempts to submit the request and to escalate were both refused because the case was no longer in TRIAGED, so the mandate has not been cancelled and no one has been told. The record shows no action taken and leaves it for a person to pick up, including the possibility of a collection already being processed, which the notes say needs separate reconciliation.

I couldn't cancel the Northmere Fitness Direct Debit mandate, and the case is now waiting with nothing more I can do.

- **Cancellation:** Mara Ellison is verified and her instruction is clear. The desk refused the request because the case is in WAITING, not TRIAGED. The recurring system had already been asked, but no answer from it is recorded in the case.
- **Escalation:** I tried to hand it to a person with a note, and that was refused for the same reason (the case isn't TRIAGED).
- **Where it stands:** The mandate has not been cancelled. Nothing has been told to the customer.

The case stays open for a person to pick up.
